text:
Maya (People Ops): Quick heads up — final SRE candidate scheduled Mon 9:00am PT. Need to confirm panel and buffers. Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123
Jordan (Hiring Manager): 9am PT works for me. Who's on for oncall/design questions?
Priya (Staff SWE): I can do design + postmortem Qs, but I have a calendar conflict from 9:30–10:00. Can we add a 10-min buffer between rounds?
Samir (SRE): I can pick up the oncall portion if Priya needs to duck. 10-min buffer sounds good.
Maya (People Ops): Ok adding a 10-min buffer after the coding exercise. I'll nudge calendar to show 1⁰0-min break.
Jordan (Hiring Manager): Quick rubric clarification: how should we weigh system design vs incident handling? Current rubric shows equal weight but I'd prefer incident handling > system design for this role.
Maya (People Ops): We can tweak the rubric for this loop. Proposed weights: Incident handling 40%, System design 30%, Coding 20%, Culture 10%. Sound okay?
Priya (Staff SWE): That distribution works for me. One ask: can someone paste the debrief form again? I want the scoring fields visible during debrief.
Maya (People Ops): Pasting form below — use 1-5 scale, include short notes. Please fill in within 24h after interview.
```
DEBRIEF FORM (SRE - Final)
- Incident handling (1-5):
- System design (1-5):
- Coding/problem solving (1-5):
- Collaboration & communication (1-5):
- Overall recommendation (Hire/No Hire/Concerns):
- Notes (brief):
```
Samir (SRE): Quick question about 'Incident handling' — do we want to explicitly ask candidate to walk through a past incident or give them a hypothetical?
Jordan (Hiring Manager): Prefer a past incident first. If nothing relevant, we can switch to hypothetical. Also give 10–12 minutes for that section.
Priya (Staff SWE): Thanks — I'll structure my questions accordingly.
Maya (People Ops): Updated calendar event with buffer + debrief form link. Also adding interviewer roles to the invite: Jordan (hiring mgr), Priya (design), Samir (oncall), +1 (backup: Elena).
Priya (Staff SWE): Heads up — if I need to drop, @Samir can pick design follow-ups too?
Samir (SRE): Yep I can take design follow-ups in a pinch.
interview-bot: Reminder set — 24h pre-interview: panel confirm ping; 1h pre-interview: join link reminder.
Maya (People Ops): Last thing — can everyone block 30 mins after for debrief? We'll try to keep it to 15 but need the room. :thumbsup:
Jordan (Hiring Manager): Blocked. See you Monday. :thumbsup:
Priya (Staff SWE): Blocked. Thanks Maya.
Samir (SRE): Blocked. I'll have notes template ready.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks all — I'll follow up if any swaps. If anyone actually needs to swap, reply here and I'll coordinate. :wave:
